cards.text: After this, Samuel, Israel's prophet, calls the people together to the LORD at Mizpah. He tells them what the LORD, the God of Israel, says. The LORD reminds them, “I brought Israel up out of Egypt, and I rescued you from the hands of the Egyptians and of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.”

cards.question: But then Samuel says that today, Israel has ___ their God, who saves them from all their troubles and afflictions.

cards.text: They've told God, “No, set a king over us.” So Samuel tells them, “Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and clans.”
So all the tribes of Israel come forward. I know this feeling, friend: YEARS in a junk drawer, holding my breath every time it opened to see who was getting picked.

cards.question: All the tribes of Israel come forward before the LORD. Which tribe is selected?
With the tribe of Benjamin selected, Samuel next has Benjamin come forward by its clans.

cards.text: Then the clan of Matri is selected. Finally, a man named Saul son of Kish is selected!
A WHOLE nation narrowed down to ONE man, they go to get him, and... NOBODY can find him.

cards.question: Nobody can find Saul son of Kish, the man who was just selected. So what do they do?
They inquire of the LORD again, “Has the man come here yet?” The LORD replies that Saul has ___ himself among the baggage.

cards.text: So they run and bring Saul, and he's a head taller than any of the others. Not bad for a man they just pulled out of the luggage.

cards.question: Samuel says to all the people, “Do you see the one the LORD has chosen? There is no one like him among all the people.” And all the people shout: long live the ___!

cards.text: Then Samuel explains the rights of kingship to the people. He writes them on a scroll.

cards.question: Samuel has written the rights of kingship on a scroll. Where does he put it?
Samuel sends all the people away, each to his own home. Saul heads to his home in Gibeah, and he goes alone.
Saul goes home with men of valor whose hearts God had touched. But some worthless men aren't on board. What do they say about Saul?

answers.text: How can this man save us
Why did this man hide from us

cards.question: Those worthless men despise Saul and bring him no gifts. How does Saul respond?

answers.text: He calls them out in public

cards.text: Not one word from the new king, and I'm impressed, because say ONE thing about my mustache and I've got a twenty-minute speech ready. But this king's story is FAR from over, friend.
